description: Start work in one call: files a new task (or takes an existing one with task_id), plans its steps, marks it in progress and starts the first step. Use this whenever the person asks for something: it puts the request on their board with a checklist and a progress bar. Returns the task id, the numbered steps with ids, the step now running and a cursor for taskhold_updates. Every event of the call (created, planned, started) carries the agent label. On a task already under way it appends the steps. Fails without title or task_id, on an unknown task_id (get one from taskhold_list) or on a step (begin its parent, or taskhold_start the step).

agent.description: Who is working, shown to the person: "<client> in <repo folder>", e.g. "Claude Code in api-server". Outside a repo just "Claude Code".

description.description: Details (markdown), e.g. the person's request in full

labels.description: Labels for a new task, e.g. ["bug", "refactor"]

priority.description: Priority of a new task (default medium)

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Matched case-insensitively; created on first use. Use this instead of project_id.

start_first_step.description: Also start the first step (default true)

steps.description: The plan, in order, e.g. ["Read the code", "Write the migration", "Add tests"]. Omit for a one-step job.

task_id.description: Begin an existing task instead of filing a new one (from taskhold_list).

title.description: Title of the new task (the person's request, short). Omit when passing task_id.

name: taskhold_begin
title: Begin a task
